title: A Begin whose control process fails to spawn is kept possibly begun with no exact replay; the host-adapter doc overstates the transport-unsent replay policy
outcome: A turn_begin whose control-process spawn fails (spawn_failed, process_never_started) before the request is handed over either keeps an exact-replay path, through the begin-replay predicate or a distinct persisted marker, or keeps a documented hold. docs/features/engram-host-adapter.md "Begin-unknown replay" states the spawn-failure case exactly. A test covers the chosen behaviour, and a containment-Resume test pins the transport_unsent admission.
acceptance: A Begin whose control process fails to spawn is kept possibly begun with no exact replay; the host-adapter doc overstates the transport-unsent replay policy is done
